Backend: 5/5 pytest passed in ~6s — /api/health 200 fast; /api/reports/dashboard 200 <10s; /api/leads?limit=50 200 returns 50 items <10s; /api/ai/analytics 200 in ~2s (concurrent gather working, previously would have hung); /api/ai/brain answered 'Top callers by conversion rate' successfully. critical_code_review_comments: server.py background _ensure_indexes() with per-index try/except is correct; consider also logging index build durations to spot future slow builds early.

routes/ai.py analytics() uses asyncio.gather + maxTimeMS=15000 — good. Consider return_exceptions=True in gather so one failed aggregation doesn't blank the whole page (currently a single failure would 500 the endpoint).
